meta.simulation_start: 2026-03-01 00:00 America/New_York (zero balance, zero customers; existing base migrated on 2026-03-02)
meta.money: major units (2 decimals). Keys ending _usd are US dollars; *_native maps are in the original currency.
meta.signs: refunds, disputes, contraction and churn are negative numbers; fees are positive costs.

definitions.month: Calendar month in the account time zone America/New_York (EDT, UTC-4, during the whole reporting period). Alternatives marked utc_months use UTC calendar months (Dashboard exports stamp times in UTC).
definitions.as_of: Snapshot figures (MRR, subscription and customer counts, balance, accounts receivable, credit balances) are point-in-time at the last second of the month. Figures built from invoices and credit notes (billings, revenue, deferred revenue, tax) use the status at export (2026-10-03): an invoice finalized in July and voided in September is excluded from July too (see billings.alternatives.including_invoices_voided_later and lists.invoices_finalized_in_month_now_void).
definitions.mrr: Primary MRR (Stripe Billing analytics convention with recurring discounts subtracted): at the last second of the month, sum over subscriptions in status active or past_due of price x quantity normalised to a month (annual / 12). Repeating and forever coupons that are still running are subtracted (percent or amount); one-time (once) coupons, taxes, one-off invoice items and manually invoiced enterprise contracts are excluded. Trialing, unpaid, paused, incomplete and canceled subscriptions count zero. Subscriptions with cancel_at_period_end=true still count until they end. pause_collection does not change status, so paused-collection subscriptions still count. Rounded to cents per customer, then converted to USD at the month-end rate (meta.fx_month_end_rates_usd_per_unit).
definitions.mrr.alternatives.list_price_no_discounts: Same as primary but no coupon is subtracted (list-price MRR).
definitions.mrr.alternatives.including_trialing: Primary plus trialing subscriptions (at their price after coupons). Includes the migrated annual customers who sit in trialing until their old renewal date.
definitions.mrr.alternatives.stripe_billing_conventi: Primary but a subscription stops counting as soon as cancel_at_period_end is set (Stripe Billing analytics drops it at the time of the cancel request).
definitions.mrr.alternatives.excluding_pause_collect: Primary without subscriptions whose collection is paused (status active, invoices voided/drafted).
definitions.mrr.alternatives.including_manual_enterp: Primary plus manually invoiced enterprise contracts whose service period covers the month end (contract amount after pre-payment credit notes / months in the term).
definitions.mrr_movement: Customer-level roll-forward between consecutive month-end snapshots of the same MRR definition. new: customer had 0 MRR at the previous month end and had never had positive MRR before this month; reactivation: 0 at previous month end, positive now, and had positive MRR at some time before this month; expansion / contraction: positive at both ends, higher / lower now; churned: positive at previous month end, 0 now (the whole previous MRR). A customer who starts and leaves inside the same month appears in none. Movements are valued at this month-end FX rate; fx_revaluation_usd is the change in the opening MRR caused by moving from last month-end rates to this month-end rates. closing = opening + fx + new + expansion + reactivation + contraction(negative) + churned(negative). net_new_mrr_usd excludes fx. by_currency_native gives the same roll-forward per currency with no FX at all.
definitions.subscriptions.active_subscriptions: Count of subscriptions in status active or past_due at the last second of the month (includes 100%-discounted, paused-collection and scheduled-to-cancel subscriptions; excludes trialing). A Business subscription has two items but is one subscription.
definitions.customers.paying_customers: Customers with primary MRR > 0 at month end (a customer with two subscriptions counts once; 100%-off customers are not paying).
definitions.churn.customers_churned: Customers with primary MRR > 0 at the previous month end and 0 at this month end.
definitions.churn.customer_churn_rate: customers_churned / paying customers at the previous month end. customer_churn_rate_stripe_style: customers_churned / (paying at previous month end + new paying customers in the month).
definitions.churn.gross_mrr_churn_rate: (churned MRR + contraction MRR) / opening MRR, all valued at this month-end FX rate. net_mrr_churn_rate: (churned + contraction - expansion) / opening; the _incl_reactivation variant also subtracts reactivation.
definitions.billings: Invoices finalized in the month (finalized_at, New York time) whose status at export is not void: sum of invoice total (after discounts, including tax) per currency; USD at the daily rate of the finalization date and at the month-end rate. Drafts are never billings. Invoices paid from customer credit balance or 100% discounted count at their total. Alternatives: UTC months; by invoice date (created, the "Date (UTC)" column) in New York or UTC months - a renewal invoice is created about an hour before it is finalized; including invoices voided later; net of credit notes issued in the month.
definitions.cash.cash_collected_usd: Gross successful payments (reporting_category charge: card charges ch_ and bank-transfer payments py_) created in the month, in USD as settled (balance transaction gross). Failed attempts, paid-out-of-band invoices, invoices settled from customer balance and test-mode rows are not cash.
definitions.cash.refunds_usd: Refund balance transactions created in the month (negative USD, converted at the refund date for EUR/GBP charges). Refund failures are shown separately (positive).
definitions.cash.fees: total_usd = fee column of every balance transaction in the month + the separate Stripe fee rows (reporting_category fee: Billing usage fee, Automatic Taxes usage fee, dispute countered fees and their refunds). fee_column_only_usd is what you get if you only sum the fee column.
definitions.cash.net_volume_usd: Net of all non-payout balance transactions created in the month (charges - fees - refunds - disputes + reversals - Stripe fee rows) = the Activity line of the Stripe balance summary.
definitions.payouts.paid_out_arrived_in_bank_usd: Payouts (not failed) whose arrival date falls in the month.
definitions.payouts.payouts_initiated_in_month_usd: Payouts created in the month (New York time), including the failed one.
definitions.payouts.in_transit_at_month_end_usd: Payouts created before month end whose arrival (bank) date is after the last day of the month. in_transit_instant_basis_usd uses the exact instant instead: automatic_payout_effective_at is the arrival date at 00:00 UTC, which is 20:00 New York time on the previous day, so a payout arriving on the 1st is already out of the balance at the New York month end.
definitions.payouts.payouts_per_stripe_balance_repor: Payouts as the Balance summary counts them: payouts whose automatic_payout_effective_at (arrival date 00:00 UTC) falls in the New York month, net of payout reversals created in the month.
definitions.balance: Stripe balance report basis: ending = starting + activity (net volume) - payouts (effective at arrival date). ending_balance_excluding_payouts_already_initiated_usd deducts payouts when created (API basis); the difference is in_transit_instant_basis_usd. available/pending split is on the API basis (available_on before month end).
definitions.revenue: Recognised revenue from finalized invoices that are not void at export: each line amount after discounts and before tax is spread evenly by the second over its service period (line period start/end); one-off items (setup, onboarding, workshop) are recognised when the invoice is finalized; proration lines use their own (often past) period, so the elapsed part is caught up in the month the invoice is finalized. Issued credit notes are negative items over the credited period, caught up at the credit-note date. Uncollectible invoices stay in revenue (write-off is a bad-debt expense). Refunds without credit notes, disputes and customer-balance credits do not change revenue. No revenue is recorded before an invoice is finalized (pending prorations are ignored). deferred_revenue_end = billed-and-not-yet-recognised at the month end. USD totals use the month-end rate. Alternatives: less_refunds_without_credit_note (such refunds, net of their tax share, treated like a credit note on the invoice service period) and excluding_uncollectible_invoices.
definitions.tax: US sales tax on invoices finalized in the month (not void), by state; credit-note tax reversals in the month shown separately; EU customers with a VAT number are reverse-charged (0 VAT, net sales listed); UK customers are not taxed (no UK registration). Stripe Tax started 2026-06-01, earlier invoices carry no tax. Alternative: tax on invoices whose paid_at is in the month.
definitions.accounts_receivable: Invoices finalized before month end, not paid, not voided and not uncollectible at month end: remaining amount after pre-payment credit notes. Uncollectible amounts are listed separately.
definitions.customer_credit_balance: Sum of negative customer balances (credit owed to customers: downgrade prorations, credit notes to balance, manual credits, annual-to-monthly switches) at month end.
